implementation: Cloud directly: small filesystem cleanup and deletion ordering repair; no local delegation.
cause: Job cleanup called Path.unlink on optimization progress.evidence directories. Run artifacts and registry records were removed before that failure, preventing normal retries.
changes: Recursively remove job-owned directories and unlink files/symlinks without following directory symlinks.
Use filename delimiters instead of an unrestricted job ID prefix when matching cleanup paths.
Check active jobs/companions and clean job files before deleting the durable record or run artifact.
Allow retry cleanup when a previous partial deletion removed the artifact, registry entry or both. Fully absent results still return HTTP 404.
